analysis.investment_thesis: Small-cap aerospace & defense play riding India's indigenization and Make-in-India tailwind, with 45%+ revenue CAGR and strong 68% promoter holding. However, 73x P/E and persistently negative operating cash flow (1 of 4 years positive) demand caution — great sector, wrong entry price.
key_strengths: Revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 45-48% over FY22-25 in a structurally expanding sector
Strong ROCE of 23.65% and promoter holding at 68% — skin in the game
Defense A&D sector benefits from government capex, PLI, and export push — 10+ year runway
key_risks: Operating cash flow negative in 3 of last 4 years despite accounting profits — working capital bleed
P/E of 73x and P/B of 10.91x leave zero margin of safety if growth slows
FII/DII holding near zero (0.67%) — liquidity and institutional validation lacking
red_flags: Cumulative FCF of -INR 65 Cr over FY23-25 vs reported PAT of INR 51 Cr — quality of earnings gap
Equity jumped from INR 25 Cr to INR 126 Cr in FY24 (dilution/QIP) funding negative OCF
analysis.detailed_analysis: The India defense story is one I would bet on heavily — indigenization, export orders, and a multi-decade capex cycle are real. This company's topline has tripled from INR 47 Cr to INR 146 Cr in three years with EBITDA margin expanding to ~28%, and a 68% promoter stake with 23.6% ROCE ticks my boxes for a credible small-cap execution story. At ~INR 1,516 Cr market cap, it could conceivably be a multibagger if it scales to INR 500-700 Cr revenue in the next 4-5 years.\n\nBut I buy growth at a reasonable price, not at any price. A 73x trailing P/E on INR 24 Cr PAT, with operating cash flow at -INR 3 Cr in FY25 and cumulative FCF of roughly -INR 65 Cr over three years, tells me earnings aren't converting to cash — classic working-capital-heavy defense order book problem. The FY24 equity infusion (INR 25 Cr → INR 126 Cr) bailed out the balance sheet. I'd keep this on the watchlist, wait for either a meaningful correction to sub-40x P/E or two consecutive years of positive OCF before committing conviction capital.
